newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Vienna ATX at new closing high, more gains seen.
newsitem.headline: Vienna ATX at new closing high, more gains seen.

text.p: 1315 GMT - Vienna's key ATX share index gains 1.43 percent to new all-time closing high of 1,309.12 points, the first time the index breached the 1,300 points mark, but driven off earlier peaks by a bout of last-minute profit taking.

Gains supported by demand for selective market heavyweights and supported by firm leads from abroad, stronger dollar. Traders expect bull run to continue over next few days, ATX seen rising to 1,350 in short-term.
* 18 ATX gainers, two losers, one share unchanged
* Top gainer VA Technologie, up 3.85 pct at 2,191.19 ATS
* June ATX futures up 20 points at 1,311.0 on volume of 804 contracts
